pages.title: Simple Frontend

frontmatter.title: Simple Frontend
frontmatter.description: Overview of the Simple Frontend panel and what it shows.

pages.content:
Simple Frontend is a test panel used by the plugin-ci-workflows test suite to check that catalog docs are validated, built and packaged.

![Simple Frontend panel](./img/panel.png)

- [Options](./options.md) lists every panel option.
- [Data formats](./data-formats.md) describes the data the panel accepts.

pages.title: Data formats

frontmatter.title: Data formats
frontmatter.description: The data frame shapes the Simple Frontend panel accepts.

pages.content: The panel accepts any data frame returned by any data source. It counts the series in the response and ignores the field values, so time series and tables both work.

pages.title: Options

frontmatter.title: Options
frontmatter.description: The options you can set on the Simple Frontend panel.

pages.content:
## Text

The text shown in the middle of the panel. Leave it empty to show only the series counter.

## Show series counter

Shows the number of series returned by the query below the text.
